content: शीर्ण [शॄ-क्त] {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Withered, decayed, rotten; शीर्णं च पतितं भूमौ पर्णं समुपयुक्तवान् <ls>Mb. 3. 38. 23</ls>. .²2 Dry, sere. .²3 Shattered, torn; shivered; क्रमशीर्णाकुलमूलसंततिः <ls>Ki. 2. 50</ls>. .²4 Thin, emaciated; (see शॄ). .²6 Small, slender. .²6 Fallen, dropped; स्वयंशीर्ण <ls>Ms. 6. 21</ls>. .{@-र्णम्@} A kind of perfume.
